readings.moment: When the temple struck ten, his watch showed four minutes to ten
He went out into the street to smoke (twenty-one minutes past ten by his watch)
The piano started in the salon as he lit his cigar
Faint quick bells heard from the master's window (twenty-six minutes to eleven by his watch)
The piano stopped (eighteen minutes to eleven by his watch)
He came back into the house (fourteen minutes to eleven by his watch)
The hall clock had just struck eleven
The hall clock's face showed two minutes past eleven when he came back into the house

whereabouts: At dinner, he quarrelled with Monnier about the repeater, in front of everyone
After dinner he sat on alone in the dining room with the brandy
He did not want to go to the salon
He went out into the street to smoke, after the temple struck ten
He stopped under the front windows of the house and stayed there
He smoked Brissagos while under the front windows
He heard the piano through the glass from under the front windows
He came back into the house at 10:46 by his watch
He went up to Félix in the library after coming back into the house
